pillars.name: Protect engineering systems
pillars.statement: Secure the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC) and delivery lifecycle by ensuring that code, build systems, and pipelines are tamper-resistant, auditable, and trustworthy.

zero_trust.verify_explicitly: Authenticate every action in the SDLC, from code commits to builds, with traceable, signed identities.
zero_trust.use_least_privilege: Restrict developer, agent, and pipeline access based on role and build context.
zero_trust.assume_breach: Segregate build systems and enforce code signed and reproducible builds to prevent tampering.

pillars.nist_csf_detail: ID: Understand build/test/deployment systems and dependencies; PR: Secure software pipelines, development tooling and artifacts; GV: Apply engineering policies, standards, secure design.

objectives.title: Complete software asset inventory
objectives.description: Build and maintain an inventory of software assets used to deploy Microsoft products and services.

objectives.title: Zero trust for source code access
objectives.description: Ensure secure access to source code and engineering systems infrastructure with Zero Trust principles and least-privilege access policies.

objectives.title: Secure code deployment
objectives.description: Protect source code that deploys Microsoft production environments with security best practices.

objectives.title: Standardize secure development pipelines
objectives.description: Secure development, build, test, and release environments with standardized, governed pipelines, and infrastructure isolation.

objectives.title: Protect the software supply chain
objectives.description: Secure the software supply chain to protect Microsoft production environments.

best_practices.practice: Run builds in secure isolated environments.
best_practices.zero_trust: Assume breach: Treat build and repo systems as potential targets. Isolate and monitor them.
best_practices.adoption_considerations: High load of upfront work to modernize pipelines and dependency tracking.

best_practices.practice: Require verified build provenance and signed artifacts.
best_practices.zero_trust: Verify explicitly: Authenticate all code commits, build actions, and releases.
best_practices.adoption_considerations: Handling legacy build tools that might not support signing or SBOM formats.

best_practices.practice: Integrate secrets scanning and SAST/DAST tools into CI/CD pipelines for code scanning.
best_practices.zero_trust: Verify explicitly: Authenticate all code commits, build actions, and releases.
best_practices.adoption_considerations: Added build-time complexity for artifact signing that significantly improves traceability.

audit_criteria.requirement: Code changes must require multiple trusted approvers
audit_criteria.rationale: Prevents unauthorized or malicious code from being merged without peer oversight.
audit_criteria.how_to_verify: Check branch protection rules for PR review requirements and CODEOWNERS enforcement.

audit_criteria.requirement: Pipelines must scan for leaked secrets and code vulnerabilities
audit_criteria.rationale: Prevents sensitive credentials and vulnerable code from reaching production.
audit_criteria.how_to_verify: Check CI/CD configurations for SAST, DAST, and secret scanning tasks.

audit_criteria.requirement: Pipelines must run with least privilege access
audit_criteria.rationale: Limits blast radius if a pipeline is compromised.
audit_criteria.how_to_verify: Check pipeline definitions for minimal permission scopes rather than global write access.

audit_criteria.requirement: Dependencies must be pinned and trusted
audit_criteria.rationale: Prevents supply chain attacks via malicious package updates.
audit_criteria.how_to_verify: Check for lockfiles and pinned versions in package manifests.

pillars.name: Monitor and detect threats
pillars.statement: Quickly detect, correlate, and prioritize security threats across Microsoft systems by unifying telemetry and analytics.

zero_trust.verify_explicitly: Use telemetry-driven, continuous validation of user, device, and workload behavior.
zero_trust.use_least_privilege: Enforce adaptive access control with detection and dynamic conditional access policies.
zero_trust.assume_breach: Detect anomalies and behavior deviations on the premise that attackers might already have access to resources.

pillars.nist_csf_detail: ID: Maintain awareness of all monitored systems; PR: Ensure protective controls generate telemetry; DE: Analyze logs and alerts to identity threats; RS: Detect trigger response workflows.

objectives.title: Complete production infrastructure inventory
objectives.description: Maintain a current resource inventory across Microsoft production infrastructure and services.

objectives.title: Standardize security log retention
objectives.description: Retain security logs for at least two years, and make six months of appropriate logs available.

objectives.title: Centralize access to security logs
objectives.description: Ensure security logs are accessible from a central data lake for efficient and effective investigation and threat hunting.

objectives.title: Detect and respond quickly
objectives.description: Detect and respond automatically to anomalous access, behavior, and configurations across Microsoft production infrastructure and services.

best_practices.practice: Centralize logs (identity, Key Vault, network, endpoint, etc.) into Microsoft Sentinel or another SIEM.
best_practices.zero_trust: Verify explicitly: Continuous validation of behavior and state against normal baselines.
best_practices.adoption_considerations: Costs for licensing and ingestion volume for Sentinel/SIEM.

best_practices.practice: Use analytics and ML-based threat detection for abnormal behavior.
best_practices.zero_trust: Assume breach: Assume that attackers might already have access, and detect attack movement quickly.
best_practices.adoption_considerations: Ongoing tuning to avoid alert fatigue. Continuous refinement and analyst training.

audit_criteria.requirement: Logs must be centrally collected and retained.
audit_criteria.rationale: Essential for retrospective threat hunting and incident investigation.
audit_criteria.how_to_verify: Check infrastructure as code for log analytics workspaces and diagnostic settings.

audit_criteria.requirement: Threat detection and alerting must be configured for critical resources.
audit_criteria.rationale: Enables rapid response to anomalous behavior.
audit_criteria.how_to_verify: Check for monitor alerts and scheduled query rules.

audit_criteria.requirement: Services must emit telemetry indicating security context.
audit_criteria.rationale: Baseline behavior modeling requires complete telemetry data.
audit_criteria.how_to_verify: Review application code for OpenTelemetry or Application Insights integration.

audit_criteria.requirement: AI systems must be threat modeled and monitored.
audit_criteria.rationale: New threat patterns like prompt injection must be detected.
audit_criteria.how_to_verify: Check for AI threat modeling artifacts and specific AI monitoring rules.

pillars.name: Accelerate response and remediation
pillars.statement: Minimize the impact and duration of security incidents with automation, coordinated response, and continuous learning.

zero_trust.verify_explicitly: Continuously reassess trust in identities, devices, and systems after detection events.
zero_trust.use_least_privilege: Automate token revocation, key rotation, and access removal during incidents.
zero_trust.assume_breach: Assume compromise and contain, then automate remediation.

pillars.nist_csf_detail: RS: Detect trigger response workflows; RC: Restore secure operations after incidents. Remediate vulnerabilities and ensure resilience.

objectives.title: Accelerate vulnerability mitigation
objectives.description: Reduce "Time to Mitigation" for high-severity cloud security vulnerabilities with accelerated response.

objectives.title: Advance transparency of cloud vulnerabilities
objectives.description: Increase transparency of mitigated cloud vulnerabilities with the adoption and release of Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and Common Platform Enumeration (CPE) industry standards.

objectives.title: Enhance public messaging and engagement
objectives.description: Improve the accuracy, effectiveness, transparency, and velocity of public messaging and customer engagement.

best_practices.practice: Develop and test incident response playbooks for common attack types.
best_practices.zero_trust: Assume breach: Treat every incident as a catalyst for architectural and procedural hardening.
best_practices.adoption_considerations: Disciplined coordination is needed between the security operations center (SOC), engineering, and leadership.

best_practices.practice: Automate token revocation, key rotation, and account disablement workflows.
best_practices.zero_trust: Use least privilege: Automate containment by restricting or removing access rapidly.
best_practices.adoption_considerations: Automation of remediation actions must balance speed and risk of disruption.

audit_criteria.requirement: Repositories must contain incident response playbooks/runbooks.
audit_criteria.rationale: Ensures teams know what to do during a security event.
audit_criteria.how_to_verify: Scan repository for runbooks and incident response documentation.

audit_criteria.requirement: Automated containment scripts/tools must be present.
audit_criteria.rationale: Minimizes incident duration via rapid revocation and isolation.
audit_criteria.how_to_verify: Check for automated revocation logic or SOAR playbook definitions.

audit_criteria.requirement: Vulnerabilities must be automatically identified and blocked or mitigated.
audit_criteria.rationale: Reduces time to mitigation for known vulnerabilities.
audit_criteria.how_to_verify: Check for dependabot or renovate configured with auto-merge for security patches.
Check for PIR templates or directories.
